title: CI failure bundle
description: Input for openteams/cog-ci-failure-analyst. PROPOSED contract: this file is what the manifest would reference as context.input_schema — shipped here as a workbench overlay so the frozen forge package stays untouched.

commit.description: FULL 40-character sha the job ran against (a provenance pin, not a label)

notes.description: Bundle caveats (redactions, truncations) — the model sees these too

evidence.description: Evidence items. Pick files (job log, workflow, diff, run history) and they become items — ids must be unique, content non-empty.
